candidates.change_summary: Non-reentrant modifier changed to set locked_ = false before function body and true after, inverting lock semantics so Put can behave differently when reentrancy attempts occur.
Non-reentrant modifier removed the require check, allowing reentrant calls and thus changing observable state after Put when reentrancy occurs.
Put now sets unlockTime to block.timestamp unconditionally (drops conditional), changing stored unlockTime observable after Put.
Put now sets unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime unconditionally (removes min with block.timestamp), allowing future unlockTime values even if in the past.
Put no longer updates balance (the line adding msg.value is removed), so balance observed after Put differs.
Replace the conditional that checks block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime with block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime so Collect can execute one block earlier.
Remove the requirement that acc.balance>=MinSum from the if-condition so small balances can be collected.
Remove the non-reentrancy guard by deleting the locked_ assignment that sets locked_ = true (making modifier ineffective), allowing reentrant Collect calls.
